verdict.rationale: RudderStack explicitly supports warehouse-native reverse ETL: syncing data from warehouse/data lake sources, defining audiences/entities via declarative YAML (Profiles) that generates warehouse-native SQL, and activating audiences to 200+ downstream tools without re-collecting data. This directly matches the story of defining models/audiences on existing warehouse tables and activating them. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the reverse ETL workflow, and more detail on model definition flexibility (e.g., SQL-based model support beyond YAML entities).
